verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own export paths: custom CSV exports, an open API, admin full spend exports via MCP, and a Transactions API backed by a public OpenAPI spec with 174 paths. Together these let data leave the platform in open formats (CSV/JSON). Nothing in the evidence documents a complete, one-shot export of ALL account data, or an offboarding path for leaving. Missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account export covering all data types (receipts, bills, cards, audit logs), an exit/offboarding procedure, and independent or hands-on confirmation that exports are complete.
